listing.name: WWE SmackDown! Here Comes the Pain — hctp-recomp (BigDaddyJRich)
listing.original_game_title: WWE SmackDown! Here Comes the Pain
listing.summary: This project recompiles EE game code and emulates the original IOP IRX modules. Stability, audio and commentary remain in development; a mentioned Windows test package does not establish a public ready-to-use release. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own NTSC-U SLUS-20787 disc and ELF, retained locally.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the public local recompilation, VU generation and build instructions with your own ELF and disc. The README mentions a separate Windows test package, but its public availability is unresolved.

warnings: This project recompiles EE game code and emulates the original IOP IRX modules. Stability, audio and commentary remain in development; a mentioned Windows test package does not establish a public ready-to-use release.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
